info.title: Topoi Quantum Tool
info.description:
Command-line tool for Topoi Quantum, providing local
      state-vector simulation, OpenQASM execution, sampling,
      expectation values and circuit inspection.

options.name: --qubits
options.description: Number of qubits to initialise, default 1

options.name: --qasm
options.description: Load and run an executable OpenQASM 3 program

options.name: --run
options.description: Run a full interpreter script and exit

options.name: --circuit
options.description: Load and run a gate-only QuantumCircuit file and exit

options.name: --print
options.description: Print final state amplitudes and probabilities
